description: A Flutter widget class 'SettingsFragment' implementing a settings screen with options like profile, favorites, language, shortcuts, about, and logout, including navigation and dialog handling.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds a settings screen with various options and navigation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the settings screen, including sections for general and others, and handles navigation and logout dialog.

methods.name: _buildSettingsItem
methods.description: Helper method to create a styled ListTile wrapped in a Card for each setting option.

methods.name: _showLogoutDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for logout, clears preferences, and navigates to OTPValidationScreen upon confirmation.
